name: stri_replace_na
title: Replace missing values in a character vector

origin.description: Replaces each missing character with a given string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coercible to one.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: A single string. The default is the text NA, not a missing value.

origin.details: Roughly str2 <- stri_enc_toutf8(str); str2[is.na(str2)] <- stri_enc_toutf8(replacement). A longer replacement warns and the first element is used. A missing replacement leaves missing values missing.

translation.description: Replaces each missing character with a given string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: One string. The default is the text "NA". NA as the replacement leaves missing values missing.

translation.details: Each NA is replaced and every other string is copied. A replacement longer than one element warns and the first element is used. An empty replacement turns missing values into empty strings.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.utils import stri_replace_na
x = ['test', NA]
print(stri_replace_na(x))
